checks.name: two independent sessions reject stale generation, bad resize and repeated close is idempotent
paused consumer bounds service output; resumed slow consumer preserves every record at natural EOF
active close keeps output reader alive and delivers all produced tail bytes before reclaim
worker crash reclaims only its Job; survivor still interactive
simultaneous natural exits keep per-session output and exit events isolated
repeated create/close releases active registry, pending requests and native workers
service normal stop cleans running Shell and native worker; all retained identities exited
